properties.title: Champagne production halves as scorching summer dents French wine grape harvest
properties.summary: France’s wine production is expected to fall below 3.4 billion liters this year as drought and repeated heat waves battered vineyards across the country, with the Champagne region worst affected, according to French government estimates published Monday. The brutal summer weather pulled harvests dramatically forward. properties.title: Thousands attend Bosnian Serb war criminal's funeral in Belgrade despite EU warnings
properties.summary: Serbian ministers attended despite earlier assurances no serving officials would be present, with Mladić's coffin arriving draped in the national flag and his medals on display. The EU said any glorification of convicted war criminals "has no place in the EU or in EU candidate countries".

properties.title: Von der Leyen: Greenland is choosing Europe and Europe is choosing Greenland
properties.summary: Greenland is making a “clear choice” to strengthen ties with the EU, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said Monday, as Brussels unveiled a €200 million investment package and moved to deepen its political, economic and security footprint in the Arctic. Speaking in Nuuk alongside Greenlandic Premier Jens-Frederik Nielsen and Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen, von der Leyen cast the relationship as a two-way partnership. properties.title: Ireland hails EU tax agreement on carbon imports and electronic waste
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — The Irish Council presidency welcomed “consensus” among governments to introduce new EU-wide levies on foreign polluters and electronic waste to finance the bloc’s next seven-year budget , according to a document seen by POLITICO. properties.title: Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić commemorated in Belgrade, but no state honours
properties.summary: Thousands are expected at Mladić's burial in Belgrade on Monday, which will proceed without serving officials, artillery salutes or ceremonial military presence. Brussels has said earlier any glorification would be "incompatible with the values on which the EU path is built".

properties.title: UN backs effort to depict Africa correctly on maps despite US opposition
properties.summary: The United Nations on Friday largely endorsed a resolution to promote maps that reflect the true scale of continents after an African-led campaign to move away from the ubiquitous 16th-century Mercator projection. The United States was the only country to vote against the initiative, denou nci ng it as part of a “much larger and more radical ideological project” and urging “countries to instill common sense to this body.” Estonia, Georgia, Lithuania, Moldova, Serbia and Ukraine abstained.
